prescriptions_axis_range.name: prescriptions_axis_range
prescriptions_axis_range.value: ("prescriptions"."od_axis" is null or "prescriptions"."od_axis" between 0 and 180) and ("prescriptions"."os_axis" is null or "prescriptions"."os_axis" between 0 and 180)

sale_items_amounts.name: sale_items_amounts
sale_items_amounts.value: "sale_items"."quantity" > 0 and "sale_items"."refunded_quantity" >= 0 and "sale_items"."refunded_quantity" <= "sale_items"."quantity" and "sale_items"."unit_price_cents" >= 0 and "sale_items"."discount_cents" >= 0 and "sale_items"."tax_cents" >= 0 and "sale_items"."net_cents" >= 0

sales_amounts.name: sales_amounts
sales_amounts.value: "sales"."subtotal_cents" >= 0 and "sales"."discount_cents" >= 0 and "sales"."tax_cents" >= 0 and "sales"."total_cents" >= 0 and "sales"."paid_cents" >= 0 and "sales"."refunded_cents" >= 0 and "sales"."refunded_cash_cents" >= 0 and "sales"."refunded_cash_cents" <= "sales"."paid_cents" and "sales"."refunded_cents" <= "sales"."total_cents" and "sales"."balance_due_cents" >= 0
